name: Village chicken
summary: Gà bản is firm, fragrant, naturally sweet chicken, boiled, steamed, grilled, or cooked with mountain vegetables. One evening plate stews it with red pumpkin. A price is Check on arrival.

The ministry’s 22 August 2024 contest note names gà bản hầm hạt dẻ and does not describe it. A price is Check on arrival.
